_README: Single source of truth for fees. Tuition, scholarship slabs, fee components and special concessions are copied from the official fee card PDF (SRU_FEE_CARD_ADMISSIONS_2027_28.pdf). Hostel room fees are NOT on that fee card; they come from the admissions handbook (backend/data/handbook/08_...). After editing, run `python scripts/export_fee_config.py` and the tests.
source: SR University Official Fee Structure & Merit Scholarship fee card, Academic Year 2027-28
needs_confirmation: ELIGIBILITY: the 2027-28 fee card lists standard fees from 50% (55% for CSE/ECE), and the agent uses that. The older programme pages on sru.edu.in (2026-27) say 60% in 10+2 PCM plus JEE Main / state entrance for B.Tech, 55% for B.Sc, B.Des, M.Sc and MBA, 50% for BBA and B.Com, 60% for BCA and MCA. Please confirm the 2027-28 minimums and get the website updated.
CSE and ECE: the fee card's standard-fee band starts at 55% (other programs at 50%). Confirm whether 50-54.9% is admissible for CSE/ECE.
JEE Main: the fee card says 90-94.5 percentile for 30% and 95+ for 40%. This file treats 90-94.99 as 30%.

IB: the fee card itself notes that 30-37 (30%) overlaps 30-33 (25%), and 35/45+ is listed for 40%. This file applies the lower figure (30-33 = 25%, 34-37 = 30%, 38+ = 40%) and tells IB students with 30-37 to confirm.
Examination fee is printed as 'Examination Fee (First Year)' Rs 5,000. This file charges it every year; confirm the amount for later years.
Specialisation fee Rs 30,000 from the second year: the fee card does not say which programs it applies to.
Hostel room fees, caution deposit and laundry are not on the fee card; they come from the admissions handbook.
No admission fee appears on the fee card (only Rs 5,000 enrolment and Rs 1,100 application form fee).

terms: Tuition fees are subject to an annual increase, irrespective of the scholarship awarded.
Special category concessions are applicable annually, subject to verification and approval of supporting documents.
Lateral entry students are eligible for the same applicable tuition fee structure and concessions as regular students, subject to university norms.
All fees, scholarships and concessions are subject to university policies and approval. The University reserves the right to revise the fee structure as per applicable regulations.
ib_overlap_note: The fee card's IB ranges overlap (30-33 under 25%, 30-37 under 30%, 35/45+ under 40%). The lower figure is applied here; the Admissions Office confirms the exact slab for IB scores 30 to 37.
website_crosscheck_note: 'website_crosscheck' records what the programme pages on sru.edu.in said on 17 Nov 2026 (those pages are for 2026-27 and older than the 2027-28 fee card). It is NOT shown to students; the fee card is the authority. It is kept so the differences can be settled with the Admissions Office.
